notes.title: Update V 0.1.30
notes.content:
The following changes have been made on level -2: 

The English voice in the radio transmission of the main warehouse has been changed. 

Two items in the backpack have been modified to show a close-up when hovered over (the valve and the saw). 

The control room chair has been made functional. 

The radio communication sound in the control room radio has been added.

notes.title: Update V 0.1.29
notes.content:
All modifications have been made on level -2:

The sound of the door leading to the main warehouse has been improved (previously it sounded on the left, now on the right, which is the direction it turns).

A radio broadcast has been added in the main warehouse radio, where the announcer talks about the national emergency situation and the bunker where the player is located. 

Interaction has been added to the note on the table in the abandoned house so that the player can pick it up and read it comfortably. 

Elements have been added to the checkpoint when exiting the elevator.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.28
notes.content:
A new options menu with more functions has been created. 

Occasional bugs when opening the backpack have been fixed.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.27
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made to level -2:

Sounds have been added to all doors. 

A background music theme has been added when discovering the bodies in the central warehouse. 

We have decorated another room: the warehouse staff's locker room. 

The access card for the elevator leading to floor -3 has been added.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.26
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made to level -2:

The 'surprise' that the central computer has stored has been added if you choose to play the role of warehouse employee in front of the central computer. 

The complete sound of the central warehouse door has also been added. 

A letter on the table in the abandoned house, revealing part of the game's story, has been added. 

A note in the metal detector room has been added, which will help you find the keys to the safe where the access card to the elevator leading to level -3 is located. 

A pareidolia in the abandoned house has been added, which will make the moment when the character gets scared more intriguing.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.25
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made to level -2:

We have added the complete sound and a removable handle to the last door leading to the elevator; now you need to get it to open the door. 

Added more combinations to the switches in the control room (now the large blue door in the warehouse opens with that system). 

Improved the camera effect inside the abandoned house (now the zoom is stable).

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.24
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made to level -2: 

Fixed the red button on the control console, which caused accidental teleportation. 

Corrected the opening of the two large doors in the main warehouse. 

Properly aligned one of the walls in the abandoned house. 

Added identification number to door number 3. 

Added more anxiolytics. Fixed a small error in the wood sawing action.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.23
notes.content:
Due to the advanced state of level -2, we have opened it to players in exploration mode. Missions will be added in the coming days, along with new areas and rooms. We hope you enjoy it as much as we are enjoying developing it.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.22
notes.content:
Added a sound volume control slider to the options menu. 

Improved the track system for bunker entry. 

Changed the access button for the backpack (now it's the right mouse button). 

Relocated the electrical system for the door leading to the elevator that goes to level -2 (now it's next to the door leading to the elevator). 

Enhanced the exterior lighting of the bunker.

notes.title: Update 0.1.21
notes.content:
Adjusted the brightness and lighting distance of the two flashlight modes.

Added various camera effects for better game immersion.

Added another battery charger in the lower part of level -1.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.20.
notes.content:
This update includes several bug fixes and some improvements:

Fixed the issue when opening the door to the hydraulic system room with a hammer, where the character would automatically walk upon opening the door.

Fixed the issue where using the TAB key inside the elevator would block player movement.

Fixed the issue where viewing the central computer screen and receiving a high anxiety notification would lock player movement and mouse controls.

Adjusted mouse sensitivity to make it smoother.

Added a hand icon in the backpack tool slot for the tool being used.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.19
notes.content:
Added a new point in the scene where the character gets scared. 

Added a mouse sensitivity slider in the options menu.

notes.title: New Update: V. 0.1.18
notes.content:
New Mechanic: Anxiety
Now the character will get scared and experience increased anxiety.
Effects of Anxiety on the Character
Backpack for storing and managing important items
Medication to control the level of anxiety

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.16
notes.content:
Fixed an error in death by entrapment. 
Implemented a system to open jammed doors. 
Added a hammer to open jammed doors. 
Added tension music theme when entering the hydraulic component room.

notes.title: Update V. 0.1.14. Mechanics, dialogues, and start menu fixes.
notes.content:
Several errors have been corrected: 

The character would get stuck between the access doors to the lower part of level -1, and couldn't get out. Now, death by entrapment has been implemented, allowing you to continue playing afterwards. 

The Walkie-Talkie could not be placed in the trays of the metal detector arch, but now it can be. 

When entering the level code to access level -1 directly from the main menu, the six-digit limit was not applied, and the player could enter infinite digits; this has also been corrected. 

A writing error in the Walkie-Talkie conversation has been fixed, and now the text matches the voice. 

The selection circle on screen has been fixed; it no longer appears in the start menu. 

We hope these improvements and corrections enhance your gaming experience. 

Thanks to "Alexmeownwn" for their suggestions and reports.

notes.title: New Update December 2024 - Bunker Descent: Trapped.
notes.content:
In this important update, we have implemented all voices and subtitles in English and Spanish. We have added a new item that will be very useful: a walkie-talkie to communicate with trapped people. We have also added new decorations in the scenery, a new game introduction with a spoken narrator, and new mechanics.
